# Notepad

> Notepad is a free, offline-capable web app for writing plain-text notes, with additional tools for markdown editing, rich-text notes, task management, kanban boards, text transformation, drawing, and focus.

Notepad stores notes locally in the browser and works offline. It does not require an account or send note contents to a server.

## Main app

- [Notepad](https://notepad.js.org/): Write and manage plain-text notes locally in your browser. It also has ambient sounds to create focused environments.

## Tools

- [Markdown Editor](https://notepad.js.org/markdown-editor/): Write and edit Markdown.
- [Rich Text Notes](https://notepad.js.org/rich-text-notes/): Create formatted rich-text notes.
- [Tasks](https://notepad.js.org/tasks/): Manage personal tasks.
- [Kanban](https://notepad.js.org/kanban/): Organize work on a Kanban board.
- [Case Converter](https://notepad.js.org/case-converter/): Convert text between different letter cases.
- [Text Tools](https://notepad.js.org/text-tools/): Use utilities for working with text.
- [Text Diff](https://notepad.js.org/text-diff/): Compare two pieces of text.
- [Voice Notes](https://notepad.js.org/voice-notes/): Create voice notes.
- [Drawingpad](https://notepad.js.org/drawingpad/): Draw and sketch in the browser.
- [Pomodoro Timer](https://notepad.js.org/pomodoro-timer/): Use a timer for focused work.
- [Deep Breath](https://notepad.js.org/deep-breath/): Use a guided breathing tool.
- [Teleprompter](https://notepad.js.org/teleprompter/): Display text as a teleprompter.
- [Tabbypad](https://notepad.js.org/tabbypad/): Work with multiple text tabs.

## Blog

- [Notepad Blog](https://notepad.js.org/blog/): Articles about Notepad and plain-text writing.
- [Simple Notepad](https://notepad.js.org/blog/simple-notepad/): Information about the simple notepad.
- [Yahoo Notepad Alternative](https://notepad.js.org/blog/yahoo-notepad-alternative/): An alternative to Yahoo Notepad.
- [Plain-Text Notepad](https://notepad.js.org/blog/plain-text-notepad/): Information about plain-text note taking.
